blocks.text: wait **for**, look **for**, ask **for**, look **after** — qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 113-dars). Bu darsda nozik farqlar: **about** bilan fe'llar va predlogsiz **discuss** tuzog'i; **care about / care for / take care of** uchligi; **ask** fe'lining predlogli va predlogsiz shakllari; **search** va **leave** fe'llarida predlog borligi-yo'qligi ma'noni o'zgartirishi; **look for / look after**. O'zbekchada bu fe'llarning ko'pi tushum kelishigi (`-ni`) bilan keladi: yordam**ni** so'ramoq, avtobus**ni** kutmoq — shuning uchun inglizchada predlog tushib qolishi eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.
about: talk, read, know, tell, do something about

«... haqida» — **about**: talk / read / know / tell somebody / ask somebody **about** something (hear about — 134-dars). **do something about** — muammoni hal qilish uchun biror chora ko'rmoq: The council should **do something about** the potholes. Lekin **discuss** — predlogsiz: we **discussed** the plan («discussed about» — xato). Ot shaklida esa about kerak: a **discussion about** the plan (→ 129-dars).

items.text: We **discussed** the budget for two hours but didn't decide anything.
items.translation: Byudjet**ni** ikki soat **muhokama qildik**, lekin hech narsani hal qilmadik.

items.text: Does anyone **know** anything **about** the new tax rules?
items.translation: Kimdir yangi soliq qoidalari **haqida** biror narsa **biladimi**?

items.text: If the noise doesn't stop, I'll have to **do something about** it.
items.translation: Shovqin to'xtamasa, bu **borasida** biror **chora ko'rishimga** to'g'ri keladi.

blocks.text: care about, care for, take care of

Uchta ifoda — uchta ma'no. **care about** — biror narsa siz uchun muhim, unga befarq emassiz: She really **cares about** the environment. Savol so'zi bilan **about** odatda tushib qoladi: I don't **care what** they think. **care for** — 1) qaramoq, parvarishlamoq (= look after): nurses **care for** patients; 2) rasmiy uslubda «yoqtirmoq», ko'pincha inkor yoki so'roqda: I don't **care for** spicy food; Would you **care for** a cup of tea? **take care of** — g'amxo'rlik qilmoq yoki biror masalani o'z zimmasiga olib hal qilmoq: Don't worry, I'll **take care of** the tickets.

**ask (somebody) for** something — biror narsani **olish** uchun so'ramoq: ask **for** help, ask **for** the bill, ask the boss **for** a pay rise. Lekin **ma'lumot** so'raganda **for** yo'q: ask somebody **the way / the time / a question / their name**. **ask (somebody) about** something — ... haqida so'ramoq: ask **about** the price. O'zbekchada hammasi «so'ramoq», shuning uchun «ask for the way», «ask a question to him» kabi xatolar ko'p uchraydi. Qoida: narsa yoki yordam olmoqchimisiz — **for**; javob yoki ma'lumot olmoqchimisiz — predlogsiz yoki **about**.

items.text: Tom **asked** his boss **for** a few days off to visit his parents.
items.translation: Tom ota-onasini ko'rgani borish uchun boshlig'i**dan** bir necha kun **javob so'radi**.

items.text: A tourist **asked** me **the way** to the railway station.
items.translation: Bir sayyoh men**dan** temir yo'l vokzaliga **yo'lni so'radi**.

items.text: The journalist **asked** the mayor **about** the new metro line.
items.translation: Jurnalist shahar hokimi**dan** yangi metro liniyasi **haqida so'radi**.

blocks.text: apply for, wait for, search for, leave for

**apply for** a job / a visa / a course — ... ga ariza bermoq; tashkilotning o'ziga esa **to**: apply **to** a university **for** a place. **wait for** somebody / something; keyin to + fe'l kelishi mumkin: We're **waiting for** the rain **to stop**. **search** — nozik farq: **search** a place / a person — tintuv qilmoq, ichini titkilab qidirmoq (The police **searched** the house); **search for** something — qidirmoq (= look for): They're still **searching for** the missing climber. **leave** ham shunday: **leave** a place — tark etmoq (predlogsiz); **leave for** a place — ... ga jo'nab ketmoq: We **leave** Tashkent **for** London tomorrow. «leave to London» — xato.

rows: **talk about** the plan — reja haqida gaplashmoq

items.text: Aziz **has applied for** a master's programme in Edinburgh.
items.translation: Aziz Edinburgdagi magistratura dasturi**ga hujjat topshirdi**.

items.text: Customs officers **searched** every suitcase on the flight **for** illegal goods.
items.translation: Bojxonachilar taqiqlangan mollarni **izlab**, reysdagi har bir chamadon**ni tintuv qilishdi**.

items.text: Our train **leaves** Bukhara **for** Khiva at seven in the morning.
items.translation: Poyezdimiz ertalab soat yettida Buxoro**dan** Xiva**ga jo'naydi**.

blocks.text: Qisqa eslatma (→ qizil kitob, 113-dars): **look for** — qidirmoq (narsa hali topilmagan), **look after** — qaramoq, g'amxo'rlik qilmoq (= take care of). O'zbekchada «qaramoq» ikki ma'noli: «rasmga qaramoq» (**look at**) va «bolaga qaramoq» (**look after**). Shuning uchun «I look at my little brother» (ukamga tikilaman) deyilib qoladi — bolaga qarab turish, parvarish qilish **look after** bo'ladi.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «discuss about» → **discuss**; «ask for the way» → **ask the way**; «ask a question to him» → **ask him a question**; «wait him» → **wait for him**; «leave to London» → **leave for London**; «search my keys» → **search for / look for my keys** (search my bag — sumkamni tintuv qilmoq); «apply to a job» → **apply for a job**; «look after my keys» → **look for my keys**; «I'll take care about it» → **take care of it**.

«**for** = olmoq, topmoq» qoidasi: ask **for**, apply **for**, wait **for**, search **for**, look **for** — hammasida siz biror narsani **olishni yoki topishni** xohlaysiz. **after** — «orqasidan»: look **after** = birovning orqasidan qarab yurmoq, ya'ni parvarish qilmoq.

Bog'lanish: to / at bilan fe'llar — 132-dars; hear / think / dream / remind (about / of) — 134-dars; pay for, blame for — 135-dars; ot + predlog (a discussion about, a request for) — 129-dars; fe'l + predlog + -ing — 62-dars.

rows: talk, read, know, tell sb, ask sb, do something about
ask (sb) for, apply for, wait for (sb to do), search for, leave (a place) for
ask sb the way / a question — for yo'q
care about (muhim), care for (qaramoq; yoqtirmoq), take care of

examples.title: **talk about**, **know about**, **tell** sb **about**
examples.description: «... haqida» — **about**: talk / read / know / tell somebody / ask somebody about. do something about — chora ko'rmoq.

sentences.text: What were you two **talking about** when I came in?
sentences.translation: Men kirganimda ikkovingiz nima **haqida gaplashayotgan** edingiz?

sentences.text: I **read about** the new airport in this morning's paper.
sentences.translation: Bugungi ertalabki gazetada yangi aeroport **haqida o'qidim**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza doesn't **know** much **about** cars, so she asked her brother for advice.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza mashinalar **haqida** ko'p narsa **bilmaydi**, shuning uchun akasidan maslahat so'radi.

sentences.text: Have you **told** your parents **about** your plans to move abroad?
sentences.translation: Chet elga ko'chish rejalaringiz **haqida** ota-onangiz**ga aytdingizmi**?

sentences.text: The government must **do something about** air pollution in big cities.
sentences.translation: Hukumat katta shaharlardagi havo ifloslanishiga qarshi biror **chora ko'rishi** kerak.

sentences.text: Nobody **asked** me **about** my experience during the interview.
sentences.translation: Suhbat paytida hech kim men**dan** tajribam **haqida so'ramadi**.

sentences.text: Jasur loves **talking about** football, especially after a big match.
sentences.translation: Jasur futbol **haqida gapirishni** yaxshi ko'radi, ayniqsa katta o'yindan keyin.

sentences.text: Is there anything we can **do about** the noise from the building site?
sentences.translation: Qurilish maydonchasidan keladigan shovqinga qarshi biror **ish qila olamizmi**?

sentences.text: Sarah **knows** a lot **about** Uzbek history because her grandfather was born in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Sara o'zbek tarixi **haqida** ko'p narsa **biladi**, chunki bobosi Buxoroda tug'ilgan.

sentences.text: **Tell** me **about** your trip! Did you get to Samarkand in the end?
sentences.translation: Sayohatingiz **haqida gapirib bering**! Oxir-oqibat Samarqandga bordingizmi?

examples.title: **discuss** (no preposition) and **talk about**
examples.description: discuss — predlogsiz: discuss the plan («discuss about» emas). talk about va ot shakli a discussion about — predlog bilan.

sentences.text: We need to **discuss** the timetable before the new term starts.
sentences.translation: Yangi semestr boshlanishidan oldin dars jadvali**ni muhokama qilishimiz** kerak.

sentences.text: The committee **discussed** the proposal but didn't vote on it.
sentences.translation: Qo'mita taklif**ni muhokama qildi**, lekin u bo'yicha ovoz bermadi.

sentences.text: Let's **talk about** it tomorrow when we're both less tired.
sentences.translation: Ertaga, ikkalamiz ham kamroq charchagan paytda bu **haqida gaplashamiz**.

sentences.text: Have the two companies **discussed** a possible merger?
sentences.translation: Ikki kompaniya qo'shilish ehtimoli**ni muhokama qildimi**?

sentences.text: There was a long **discussion about** salaries at the staff meeting.
sentences.translation: Xodimlar yig'ilishida maoshlar **haqida** uzoq **muhokama** bo'ldi.

sentences.text: I'd rather not **discuss** my private life with colleagues.
sentences.translation: Shaxsiy hayotim**ni** hamkasblar bilan **muhokama qilmaganim** ma'qul.

sentences.text: Kate and her husband **talked about** moving to the countryside for years.
sentences.translation: Keyt va eri yillar davomida qishloqqa ko'chish **haqida gaplashib yurishdi**.

sentences.text: The doctor **discussed** the risks of the operation with Bekzod's family.
sentences.translation: Shifokor operatsiya xavflari**ni** Bekzodning oilasi bilan **muhokama qildi**.

sentences.text: What did you **discuss** at the meeting? — Mainly the problems with the new software.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishda nima**ni muhokama qildingiz**? — Asosan yangi dasturdagi muammolarni.

sentences.text: Rather than **discussing** the problem for weeks, let's **do something about** it now.
sentences.translation: Muammo**ni** haftalab **muhokama qilish** o'rniga, hozir unga qarshi biror **chora ko'raylik**.

examples.title: **care about**, **care for**, **take care of**
examples.description: care about — ... ga befarq emas; care for — qaramoq, parvarishlamoq yoki (rasmiy) yoqtirmoq; take care of — g'amxo'rlik qilmoq, hal qilmoq. don't care + what / where — predlogsiz.

sentences.text: Young people today really **care about** the environment.
sentences.translation: Bugungi yoshlar atrof-muhit **haqida** chindan **qayg'uradi**.

sentences.text: Nilufar gave up her job to **care for** her sick mother.
sentences.translation: Nilufar kasal onasi**ga qarash** uchun ishini tashladi.

sentences.text: Don't worry about the bills — I'll **take care of** them.
sentences.translation: Hisoblar haqida qayg'urmang — ular**ni** o'zim **hal qilaman**.

sentences.text: I don't **care** what people think — I'm going to wear this hat.
sentences.translation: Odamlar nima deb o'ylashi**ning** men uchun **farqi yo'q** — bu shlyapani kiyaman.

sentences.text: Would you **care for** something to drink while you wait?
sentences.translation: Kutib turganingizda biror narsa ichishni **xohlaysizmi**?

sentences.text: Who **takes care of** your dog when you're travelling for work?
sentences.translation: Ish bilan safarga ketganingizda itingiz**ga** kim **qaraydi**?

sentences.text: The only thing Oliver **cares about** is money, unfortunately.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, Oliver**ni qiziqtiradigan** yagona narsa — pul.

sentences.text: The staff at this home **care for** thirty elderly people.
sentences.translation: Bu qariyalar uyining xodimlari o'ttizta keksa odam**ni parvarishlashadi**.

sentences.text: I don't really **care for** horror films, but my brother loves them.
sentences.translation: Men qo'rqinchli filmlar**ni** unchalik **yoqtirmayman**, lekin akam ularni juda yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: If you really **cared about** your health, you would stop smoking.
sentences.translation: Agar sog'lig'ingiz**ni** chindan **o'ylaganingizda**, chekishni tashlagan bo'lardingiz.

examples.title: **ask for** / **ask** somebody something / **ask about**
examples.description: Narsa yoki yordam olmoqchi bo'lsangiz — ask (sb) **for**; ma'lumot — ask sb the way / the time / a question (predlogsiz); mavzu — ask (sb) **about**.

sentences.text: If you need anything, just **ask for** it at reception.
sentences.translation: Biror narsa kerak bo'lsa, qabulxonada shunchaki **so'rang**.

sentences.text: Excuse me, can I **ask** you **the way** to the Old Town?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, siz**dan** Eski shaharga **yo'lni so'rasam** bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: Madina **asked** her manager **for** a pay rise, and to her surprise she got one.
sentences.translation: Madina menejeri**dan** maoshini oshirishni **so'radi** va kutilmaganda unga oshirib berishdi.

sentences.text: The children **asked** me so many **questions** that I couldn't finish my coffee.
sentences.translation: Bolalar men**ga** shunchalik ko'p **savol berishdiki**, qahvamni ichib bo'la olmadim.

sentences.text: Did anyone **ask about** the price when you showed them the flat?
sentences.translation: Kvartirani ko'rsatganingizda kimdir narx **haqida so'radimi**?

sentences.text: We **asked for** a table by the window, but the restaurant was full.
sentences.translation: Deraza yonidan stol **so'radik**, lekin restoran to'la edi.

sentences.text: Tom never **asks for** help, even when he's clearly struggling.
sentences.translation: Tom, hatto qiynalayotgani aniq ko'rinib tursa ham, hech qachon **yordam so'ramaydi**.

sentences.text: Why don't you **ask** the driver **what time** the last bus leaves?
sentences.translation: Nega haydovchi**dan** oxirgi avtobus soat nechada jo'nashini **so'ramaysiz**?

sentences.text: Several customers have **asked about** delivery to Fergana.
sentences.translation: Bir nechta xaridor Farg'onaga yetkazib berish **haqida so'rashdi**.

sentences.text: Instead of **asking** me **for** money again, why don't you find a part-time job?
sentences.translation: Men**dan** yana pul **so'rash** o'rniga, nega yarim stavkali ish topmaysan?

examples.title: **apply for**, **wait for** somebody **to** do
examples.description: apply for a job / a visa / a course (tashkilotga — apply **to**); wait for somebody / something, wait for somebody **to do** something.

sentences.text: Bekzod is going to **apply for** a job at the new hospital.
sentences.translation: Bekzod yangi shifoxonadagi ish**ga ariza bermoqchi**.

sentences.text: We're **waiting for** the rain **to stop** before we leave.
sentences.translation: Ketishdan oldin yomg'ir **to'xtashini kutyapmiz**.

sentences.text: How many universities did you **apply to** last year?
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili nechta universitet**ga hujjat topshirdingiz**?

sentences.text: Kate has **applied for** a scholarship to study medicine in Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Keyt Edinburgda tibbiyot o'qish uchun grant**ga ariza topshirdi**.

sentences.text: I'm still **waiting for** the company **to reply** to my complaint.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya shikoyatimga **javob berishini** hali ham **kutyapman**.

sentences.text: To **apply for** a tourist visa, you need a passport and two photos.
sentences.translation: Turistik viza**ga ariza berish** uchun pasport va ikkita surat kerak.

sentences.text: There's no point **waiting for** Jasur — he's always at least half an hour late.
sentences.translation: Jasur**ni kutishning** foydasi yo'q — u doim kamida yarim soat kechikadi.

sentences.text: Thousands of graduates **apply for** jobs at this bank every year.
sentences.translation: Har yili minglab bitiruvchilar bu bankdagi ish o'rinlari**ga ariza topshirishadi**.

sentences.text: The passengers sat on the plane for an hour **waiting for** the fog **to clear**.
sentences.translation: Yo'lovchilar tuman **tarqalishini kutib** samolyotda bir soat o'tirishdi.

sentences.text: What exactly are we **waiting for**? Let's start the meeting without them.
sentences.translation: Aslida nima**ni kutyapmiz**? Yig'ilishni ularsiz boshlaylik.

examples.title: **search** a place **for**; **leave** a place **for**
examples.description: search a place (for something) — tintuv qilmoq; search for — qidirmoq. leave a place — tark etmoq; leave for a place — ... ga jo'namoq.

sentences.text: Police **searched** the whole flat but found nothing.
sentences.translation: Politsiya butun kvartira**ni tintuv qildi**, lekin hech narsa topmadi.

sentences.text: Rescue teams are still **searching for** the two missing climbers.
sentences.translation: Qutqaruvchilar hali ham yo'qolgan ikki alpinist**ni qidiryapti**.

sentences.text: At the airport, security staff **searched** my bag **for** liquids.
sentences.translation: Aeroportda xavfsizlik xodimlari suyuqlik **bor-yo'qligini** tekshirib, sumkam**ni tintuv qilishdi**.

sentences.text: When do you **leave for** Oxford? — On Thursday morning.
sentences.translation: Oksford**ga** qachon **jo'naysiz**? — Payshanba kuni ertalab.

sentences.text: Aziz **left** Tashkent at the age of eighteen and never came back.
sentences.translation: Aziz o'n sakkiz yoshida Toshkent**ni tark etdi** va hech qachon qaytmadi.

sentences.text: I've **searched** everywhere **for** my passport, but it's disappeared.
sentences.translation: Pasportim**ni** hamma joydan **qidirdim**, lekin u g'oyib bo'lgan.

sentences.text: Our group **leaves** Samarkand **for** Bukhara on the morning train.
sentences.translation: Guruhimiz ertalabki poyezdda Samarqand**dan** Buxoro**ga jo'naydi**.

sentences.text: Scientists have been **searching for** a cure for this disease for decades.
sentences.translation: Olimlar o'n yillardan beri bu kasallikka davo **qidirib kelishmoqda**.

sentences.text: Sarah **left** her job at the bank and **left for** Canada a week later.
sentences.translation: Sara bankdagi ishi**dan ketdi** va bir haftadan keyin Kanada**ga jo'nab ketdi**.

sentences.text: Before we **leave for** the airport, let's **search** the room once more.
sentences.translation: Aeroport**ga jo'nashdan** oldin, xona**ni** yana bir bor **tekshirib chiqaylik**.

examples.title: **look for** or **look after**?
examples.description: look for — qidirmoq (= search for), look after — qaramoq, g'amxo'rlik qilmoq (= take care of). Oxirgi gapda ikkalasi birga.

sentences.text: My neighbour **looks after** our cat whenever we go to Fergana.
sentences.translation: Farg'onaga har safar borganimizda qo'shnim mushugimiz**ga qarab turadi**.

sentences.text: Jasur has been **looking for** a flat near the university for months.
sentences.translation: Jasur oylardan beri universitet yaqinidan kvartira **qidiryapti**.

sentences.text: Who's going to **look after** the shop while you're in hospital?
sentences.translation: Siz kasalxonadaligingizda do'kon**ga** kim **qarab turadi**?

sentences.text: Are you **looking for** anything in particular, or just browsing?
sentences.translation: Biror narsani aniq **qidiryapsizmi** yoki shunchaki tomosha qilyapsizmi?

sentences.text: Grandparents often **look after** the children while both parents work.
sentences.translation: Ota-ona ikkalasi ishlaganda bolalar**ga** ko'pincha bobo-buvilar **qarashadi**.

sentences.text: The company is **looking for** experienced engineers who speak English.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya ingliz tilida gapiradigan tajribali muhandislar**ni qidiryapti**.

sentences.text: You need to **look after** yourself better — you look exhausted.
sentences.translation: O'zingiz**ga** yaxshiroq **qarashingiz** kerak — juda holdan toygan ko'rinasiz.

sentences.text: I spent the whole morning **looking for** my glasses, and they were on my head!
sentences.translation: Butun ertalab ko'zoynagim**ni qidirdim**, u esa boshimda ekan!

sentences.text: Nurses who **look after** patients at night deserve better pay.
sentences.translation: Kechalari bemorlar**ga qaraydigan** hamshiralar yaxshiroq maoshga loyiq.

sentences.text: While Emma was **looking for** a job in London, her sister **looked after** her two boys.
sentences.translation: Emma Londondan ish **qidirayotganida**, uning ikki o'g'li**ga** singlisi **qarab turdi**.

examples.title: Mixed: a busy week
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: about, for, of, after — talk about, discuss, ask for, apply for, wait for, care about, take care of, look after.

sentences.text: Before you **apply for** the job, **ask** the company **about** working hours.
sentences.translation: Ish**ga ariza berishdan** oldin, kompaniya**dan** ish vaqti **haqida so'rang**.

sentences.text: We **discussed** the problem for hours, but nobody wanted to **do anything about** it.
sentences.translation: Muammo**ni** soatlab **muhokama qildik**, lekin hech kim unga qarshi biror **chora ko'rishni** istamadi.

sentences.text: Madina **looks after** her grandmother because she really **cares about** her.
sentences.translation: Madina buvisi**ga qaraydi**, chunki u **haqida** chin dildan **qayg'uradi**.

sentences.text: I've been **waiting for** an answer for weeks, so I'm going to **ask for** my money back.
sentences.translation: Haftalab javob **kutyapman**, shuning uchun pulimni qaytarishni **so'rayman**.

sentences.text: When Tom **left** home **for** university, his parents didn't **know** much **about** his new life.
sentences.translation: Tom uyi**dan** universitet**ga ketganda**, ota-onasi uning yangi hayoti **haqida** ko'p narsa **bilishmasdi**.

sentences.text: Could you **take care of** the tickets while I **look for** a hotel?
sentences.translation: Men mehmonxona **qidirgunimcha**, chiptalar masalasi**ni hal qilib** tura olasizmi?

sentences.text: The police **searched** the area, **looking for** the missing child.
sentences.translation: Politsiya yo'qolgan bola**ni qidirib**, hudud**ni tintuv qildi**.

sentences.text: Nobody **asked** us **for** our opinion — they just told us what to do.
sentences.translation: Hech kim biz**dan** fikrimiz**ni so'ramadi** — shunchaki nima qilishni aytishdi.

sentences.text: Oliver doesn't **care about** fashion; he just **asks for** the cheapest jacket in the shop.
sentences.translation: Oliver moda**ga befarq**; do'konda shunchaki eng arzon kurtka**ni so'raydi**.

sentences.text: What did you **talk about** with the director? — We **discussed** my contract.
sentences.translation: Direktor bilan nima **haqida gaplashdingiz**? — Shartnomam**ni muhokama qildik**.
